liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loser** (1 review): Left off the official release, and Loser is also absent from Europe '72 [7]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Full-blown, long and roaring version [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-04-26.sbd.backus.12884.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 222 min; rated 4.6/5 by 15 [1]
- **gd72-04-26.sbd.vernon.12849.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 79 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1972-04-26.sbd.vernon.9197.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 74 min; rated 4.57/5 by 21 [4]. Said about its sound: These outtake tracks sound better than the songs that were officially released; This copy of the outtakes has a lot of hiss; Recording has some hiss but is a great soundboard [10][14][15]
- **gd1972-04-26.136637.sbd.mr.sirmickflac1648**: soundboard; 28 songs; 190 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Listing says Casey Jones, but the track is actually El Paso [12]
- The official release moved the end of the second set onto the first disc's second half, which this reviewer dislikes [5]
- The official two-CD release split the show and moved tracks from one set to the other [6]
- The Other One here is stronger than the more restrained versions on 4/11 and 4/16 [7]
- The date is featured on the Hundred Year Hall release [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-04-26.sbd.vernon.12849.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Combining the official Hundred Year Hall CD with the outtakes reconstructs the complete, unedited show across four discs [5]
- **gd1972-04-26.sbd.vernon.9197.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD>MR>DAT>SS>CDR [4]
- **gd1972-04-26.136637.sbd.mr.sirmickflac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Soundboard > Master Reel > Dat (48k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Pandora: [Goin' down the Road Feeling Bad (Live at Jahrhundert Halle, Frankfurt, Germany, April 26, 1972) (feat. Merle Saunders)](https://www.pandora.com/artist/grateful-dead/hundred-year-hall-live/goin-down-the-road-feeling-bad-live-at-jahrhundert-halle-frankfurt-germany-april-26-1972-feat-merle-saunders/TRKwk9qV3qj776q) [18]
